usdRate.sourceName: Banky Foiben'i Madagasikara, interbank foreign exchange market (MID rate), 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: US dollar MID rate on the interbank market; 4,572.79 on 2 November 2026. World Bank 2025 average 4,529.8.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Banky Foiben'i Madagasikara (BFM), inflation rate (year-on-year change of the consumer price index, base 2016), August 2026
inflation_cpi.note: 8.6% year on year in August 2026 (INSTAT index, shown by the central bank); World Bank 2025 average 8.05%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BFM medium-term inflation objective (5%); World Bank CPI 2021-2025 (about 6-10% a year)
inflation_projection.note: Inflation has run at 7-10% a year since 2022 (8.05% in 2025, 8.6% in August 2026) against the central bank's 5% medium-term aim, so a rounded 7% is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: BFM, key indicators (taux directeur), valid from 5 August 2026
policy_rate.note: Raised from 12.00% to 12.50% by the Monetary Committee on 4 August 2026, effective 5 August 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: No published typical rate on ordinary savings accounts was found; BFM publishes only an average bank deposit rate (3.99% in August 2026) and per-bank minimum/maximum tables that could not be read.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published typical 3-month term deposit rate was found; BFM's interest-rate structure tables (Structure des taux d'intérêts 2026) could not be opened.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published typical 1-year term deposit rate was found; BFM's interest-rate structure tables could not be opened.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BFM, key indicators (weighted average deposit rate of banks, taux créditeur des banques), August 2026
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate banks pay on deposits; average lending rate 13.34% in the same month. The World Bank's 2025 deposit-rate figure (12.1%) is not used because it disagrees with the central bank's series.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Direction Générale du Trésor, Bons du Trésor Fihary (BTF) issue of 1-15 October 2026
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: 3-year BTF at 10.00% (1 year 7.30%, 2 years 8.80%); BTF are sold to individuals from 1 million ariary at Treasury offices and are the longest retail government security (no 5-year issue). The November 2026 issue keeps the same rates. Treasury site is served over http only.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BFM, results of the last 5 Treasury bill (BTA) auctions, 12-week bill on 9 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average rate on the 12-week (84-day) BTA; 3.05% on 28 September 2026. The 52-week BTA yielded 7.23% on 9 October 2026. Short bill yields sit far below the 12.5% policy rate because the Treasury allots little at short tenors; the BFM key-indicators sheet gives 5.13% as the average Treasury bill rate on 21 October 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond is issued on the domestic market; the Treasury issues bills (BTA, up to 52 weeks) and BTF of 1-3 years only.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond is issued on the domestic market; the Treasury issues bills (BTA, up to 52 weeks) and BTF of 1-3 years only.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Code Général des Impôts 2026 (Loi de finances 2026), articles 01.04.03, 01.04.04 and 01.04.10 (IRCM)
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on bank placements is subject to the tax on income from movable capital (IRCM) at 20%, withheld by the payer and final; interest on demand (current) deposits is exempt.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Code Général des Impôts 2026, article 01.04.03 (IRCM on Bons du Trésor Fihary and BTA)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Income from BTA and BTF is expressly subject to IRCM at 20%.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No operating deposit guarantee scheme or cover limit was found on the central bank's banking-supervision pages (banking law 2020-011).

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BFM, key indicators (weighted average lending rate of banks, taux débiteur des banques), August 2026
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Average rate across all bank lending, not card-specific; no legal cap or card rate is published.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No stock exchange in Madagascar; global equities in ariary terms (BFM exchange rates)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for global equities with a stable ariary.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No stock exchange in Madagascar; global equities in ariary terms; BTF 1-year 7.3% (5.8% after IRCM)
equity_return_base.note: Madagascar has no stock market, so the base uses a global index in ariary terms (about 7% in dollars plus 3-4% ariary depreciation), capped at the 5.8% after-tax 1-year Treasury rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equities in ariary terms (BFM exchange rates)
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equities and faster ariary depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BFM exchange rates (ariary per US dollar)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with slow ariary depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BFM exchange rates (about 4,570 ariary per dollar in October 2026, against about 4,530 on average in 2025 and 3,300 in 2016)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus about 4% a year ariary depreciation against the dollar.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and faster ariary depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BFM key indicators (average deposit rate 3.99%, August 2026); IRCM 20%
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary bank deposits at about 4% less 20% IRCM.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Treasury BTF October 2026 (1 year 7.30%); BFM BTA 52-week 7.23%; IRCM 20%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 1-year BTF or 52-week bills at about 7.3% less 20% IRCM (about 5.8%), rounded down.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 3-year BTF at 10% less 20% IRCM (8%), rounded down.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The insurance supervisor (CSBF at the central bank) publishes no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published indicative term-life premium rates per 1,000 ariary of cover were found from the supervisor or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Madagascar was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Madagascar
oop_health_share.note: 27.4% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI series was read; private medical costs usually rise faster than general prices, so 2 points above the 7% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI series was read; private school fees usually rise faster than general prices, so 2 points above the 7% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Madagascar
life_expectancy.note: 63.8 years in 2024 (men 62.1, women 65.6); UN WPP 2024 gives 64.3 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; by-sex values are the 5-year age-band figures; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.03 (2025, World Bank), 7.3 (2040) and 11.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/madagascar/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), Madagascar social security scheme, 2026
retirement_age_default.note: CNaPS old-age pension at 60 for men and women, with 15 years of affiliation and 28 quarters of contributions in the last 10 years; up to 5 years earlier for 60%+ incapacity. No different rule for people born after 1975 was found.

retirement_age_government.note: The current retirement age for civil servants (Caisse de Retraite Civile et Militaire) could not be confirmed from an official source; a 2016 press report of a rise to 65 was not verified.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BFM key indicators (average deposit rate 3.99%, August 2026); IRCM 20%
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary bank deposits less 20% IRCM.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: about the 1-year BTF or 52-week bill yield after 20% IRCM (5.8%), rounded down; not above the after-tax safe rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Treasury BTF October 2026 (2 years 8.80%, 3 years 10.00%); IRCM 20%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in 2-3 year BTF at 7-8% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Treasury BTF and BFM deposit rates; IRCM 20%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about after-tax Treasury and deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Treasury BTF October 2026; equity base 9.5%; gold base 8%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of BTF, global equities held in ariary terms and some gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension open to people planning today was found; the CNaPS 'allocation de solidarité' is a closed legacy benefit for people employed in 1964-1968 (CLEISS 2026).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code's rules on a retirement or end-of-service indemnity for private employees could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CLEISS, Madagascar social security scheme (CNaPS old-age pension), 2026
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory CNaPS pension for private employees from 60: 30% of the annual minimum wage plus 20% of revalued average pay of the last 10 years plus 1% per extra 4 quarters, floor 60% of the minimum wage, cap 75% of average pay. Past wages are revalued but no automatic indexation of pensions is described, so inflationLinked is false; tax treatment not stated.

savings_account.note: Banking products are sold in French; interest is subject to 20% IRCM except on demand deposits.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with published rates was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Issued monthly by the Treasury for 1, 2 and 3 years from 1 million ariary; bought at Treasury offices in Antananarivo and the regions.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned every two weeks at the central bank for 4-52 weeks; minimum bid 20 million ariary, open to individuals.

tbond_5y.note: No 5-year government bond on the domestic market; the longest retail security is the 3-year BTF.

tbond_10y.note: No 10-year government bond on the domestic market.

equity_fund.note: Madagascar has no stock exchange and no retail equity funds were found.

gold.note: Gold is mainly bought as jewellery; the central bank describes its gold operations at https://www.banky-foibe.mg/operations-sur-lor/.

insuranceRegulator.name: Commission de Supervision Bancaire et Financière (CSBF)
insuranceRegulator.note: Supervises insurers under the insurance law 2020-005; housed at the central bank.
